## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Refactoring / Security / Performance improvement

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of Lancy.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have verified that frontend (`npm run build`) and backend (`npm run build` in `backend/`) compile cleanly.
- [ ] I have added tests verifying my authorization and data validation changes.
- [ ] Security considerations have been audited (No secret leakage or IDOR vulnerability).
